method: Opened primary official documents and developer-authored GitHub issues via web tools. Short quotes only; claims and limitations are paraphrases. No live account/login/paid model turn, no source code mutation.

sources.title: MCP transport security
sources.excerpt: Servers MUST validate the Origin header
sources.claim: Local HTTP requires Origin validation, loopback bind and authentication; lost stream is not cancellation.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: MCP security boundaries
sources.excerpt: MCP Servers MUST NOT use sessions for authentication.
sources.claim: Authorize each inbound request; session handles are transport state, not principal credentials; do not forward arbitrary upstream credentials.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: Claude credential namespace

sources.title: Bounded context and selective retrieval
sources.excerpt: the smallest possible set of high-signal tokens
sources.claim: Use references and selective retrieval; compaction can discard critical detail. Supports bounded cited packs and separate research workers, not unbounded prompt injection or native cross-provider session portability.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: Durable incremental handoff
sources.claim: Structured progress and Git history help fresh agents resume; one feature and verification per iteration reduce false completion. Supports a central plan with bounded packets.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: Compaction loses critical instructions
sources.excerpt: Auto-compact context summarization loses critical instructions and workarounds
sources.claim: Reporter documents instruction loss; use as an adversarial fixture and reassert pinned protocol/rules after compaction, not a universal rate estimate.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: Reflexion primary paper
sources.claim: The authors study reflection plus episodic text memory without weight updates. Their benchmark does not establish Fabric improvement; require local held-out evaluation, contrast evidence and Board approval.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: PostgreSQL lexical text search
sources.claim: FTS uses parsed lexemes, configurations and explicit ranking; language normalization and identifier behavior must be corpus-tested. Index all covered sources; bound returned bytes separately.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: PostgreSQL trigram fallback
sources.claim: pg_trgm offers similarity and indexed matching; it is an optional measured fallback for identifiers/substrings, not semantic truth or a replacement for scope filters.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: Origin interoperability discussion
sources.claim: Developer reports native Origin-absent requests working while browser clients are refused. A remote deployment discussion does not justify relaxing Fabric local-origin checks.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.

sources.title: Codex app-server protocol
sources.claim: Primary app-server README is rolling main. Pin generated schema to installed CLI and match thread/turn identities and explicit notifications; no portable native Claude session claim.
sources.limitations: Rolling docs/issues are research evidence, not installed-build/product acceptance.
